result.question: Why did priests say Uzziah trespassed?

readings.answer: Because he tried to offer incense, which only consecrated descendants of Aaron (priests) may do.
readings.support: you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense

assessments.reason: It matches v.18: “You have no right to offer incense… Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense,” which is the stated reason for their rebuke.
This repeats the charge (“you have acted unfaithfully”) rather than the reason; the passage grounds the trespass in the exclusive priestly right to burn incense (v.18).

result.reason: v.18 explicitly states that only priests, descendants of Aaron, may burn incense, which directly answers the why.
